command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$p" ] || exit 0; case "$p" in *.ts|*.vue) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; pkg=$(printf '%s' "$p" | sed -nE 's#.*packages[/\\]([^/\\]+)[/\\].*#\1#p'); [ -n "$pkg" ] || exit 0; [ -f "packages/$pkg/package.json" ] || exit 0; pnpm --filter "@liftr/$pkg" run typecheck
